recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser-native endless runner called **Neon Webshift Runner**. Preserve a fixed-x runner who jumps with one tap, can double jump before landing, runs across horizontally scrolling platforms, scores by passing normal platforms, fails by falling or touching red hazard platforms, and instantly restarts from a game-over screen. Reinterpret the loop as a satirical synthwave multiverse sprint after work: the player is a neon webshift avatar, platforms are web lanes, hazards are canon traps, score is web lanes cleared, and failure is being “Canon Evented.” Use procedural canvas art for animated portals, skyline, scanlines, grid depth, glowing lanes, and a web-masked runner. Use catalog-backed Orbitron, Rajdhani, and Bangers fonts; keep mobile CTAs large and readable; use compact catalog GIF reactions only as optional feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a mobile-friendly canvas endless runner. The player remains at a fixed horizontal position while platforms scroll left. A tap, click, Space, or ArrowUp triggers a jump, with exactly two jumps allowed before landing. Normal platforms reset jumps and increment distance score after being passed. Red kill platforms appear after early progress and cause failure on contact. Falling below the viewport also causes failure. Start, game over, and restart screens form an instant replay loop.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb tap/click jump plus keyboard Space/ArrowUp.
- Double-jump cap: two jumps before landing.
- Gravity, vertical velocity, fixed player x-position, and scrolling-platform runner model.
- Random platform gaps/widths, speed rising with score, and red hazard spawning after score is above 5.
- Distance score increments only when a normal platform is passed.
- Failure by falling or touching a red hazard, followed by restart.

## Remix blueprint
The rebuilt game is **Neon Webshift Runner**, a satirical synthwave multiverse runner. The old sky courier becomes a neon webshift avatar sprinting after work through glitch lanes. Normal platforms become web lanes, red kill platforms become canon traps, score becomes web lanes cleared, and failure becomes being “Canon Evented.” Presentation is rebuilt with procedural portals, neon skyline, grid floor, web-masked runner silhouette, meme-tone HUD copy, catalog-backed fonts, catalog-backed reaction GIFs, and WebAudio-generated SFX.
